titoloPagina: What does an SEO specialist do?
cosa: Makes sure the website shows up among the top Google results, without paying.
giornata: Finds the words people type into Google
Improves page titles and copy
Checks the website for technical errors
tiPiaceSe: You'll like it if you love writing, analysing and solving small puzzles.

titoloPagina: What does a SEA / PPC specialist do?
cosa: Runs paid ads on search engines: you only pay when someone clicks.
giornata: Chooses the words the ads should appear for
Writes short ads and compares them
Checks how much each customer costs
tiPiaceSe: You'll like it if you enjoy numbers and want to see results quickly.

titoloPagina: What does a brand manager do?
cosa: Decides how the company presents itself: name, values, tone of voice, colours.
giornata: Checks that posts and ads follow the brand style
Writes the brand guidelines
Compares the brand with competitors
tiPiaceSe: You'll like it if you have an eye for detail and often wonder why you like a brand.

titoloPagina: What does a social media manager do?
cosa: Runs the company's social media profiles: what to post, when, and how to reply.
giornata: Prepares the post calendar
Replies to comments
Looks at which posts work best
tiPiaceSe: You'll like it if you use social media a lot and have ideas for content.

cosa: Chooses the right creators and organises collaborations with them.
giornata: Looks for creators who fit the brand
Writes the brief for the collaboration
Checks that sponsored posts are disclosed (e.g. #ad)
tiPiaceSe: You'll like it if you follow lots of creators and can tell who is credible.

titoloPagina: What does a CRM manager do?
cosa: Looks after people who have already bought, so they come back.
giornata: Splits customers into groups
Prepares automated emails (welcome, abandoned cart)
Measures how many customers come back
tiPiaceSe: You'll like it if you love order and see customers as long-term relationships.

cosa: Explains why a product is useful and prepares its launch.
giornata: Talks with the product team
Writes the product's key message
Prepares materials for the launch
tiPiaceSe: You'll like it if you can explain complicated things in a simple way.

cosa: Helps products sell in shops and through distributors.
giornata: Decides how products are displayed on the shelves
Organises in-store promotions
Analyses sales shop by shop
tiPiaceSe: You'll like it if you're curious about what happens inside a supermarket.

titoloPagina: What does a PR and communication specialist do?
cosa: Looks after the company's reputation with journalists and the public.
giornata: Writes press releases
Keeps in touch with journalists
Prepares answers in case of a crisis
tiPiaceSe: You'll like it if you write well and stay calm under pressure.

titoloPagina: What does a partnerships manager do?
cosa: Builds collaborations with other companies to grow together.
giornata: Looks for companies with the same audience
Proposes deals that benefit both sides
Measures the results of collaborations
tiPiaceSe: You'll like it if you love meeting people and negotiating.

cosa: Finds out who the customers are, what they want and what they think of the brand.
giornata: Prepares surveys
Interviews customers
Sums up the results in a few clear ideas
tiPiaceSe: You'll like it if you always ask questions and are interested in psychology.

titoloPagina: What does a marketing analytics specialist do?
cosa: Collects data and chooses the tools that make marketing work.
giornata: Checks that the website data is correct
Builds reports
Connects the tools to each other
tiPiaceSe: You'll like it if you enjoy data, technology and putting things in order.
